title: HR
tagline: Master HR strategies, recruitment, and employee management.
description: Move beyond HR theory into how people functions actually run — sourcing and hiring talent, managing performance, and handling the day-to-day operations and compliance that keep a workforce functioning. Built for anyone starting or strengthening an HR career.
outcomes: Run end-to-end recruitment and selection processes
Apply core HR strategy, policy, and compliance fundamentals
Manage employee onboarding, engagement, and performance
Use HR metrics to support business decisions

topics: Role of HR in business strategy
Design a full recruitment process for a role
Present an HR policy or engagement plan

projects: Design and run a mock end-to-end recruitment drive
Build an employee engagement or onboarding plan

faqs.q: Is this suitable for someone new to HR?
faqs.a: Yes — the program starts from HR fundamentals and builds up to operational skills, no prior HR role required.

faqs.q: Does it cover Indian labor law specifics?
faqs.a: Yes — employment law and compliance modules are grounded in Indian HR practice.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Live and Self-Paced?
faqs.a: Live batches include instructor-led sessions, real-time doubt clearing, and mentorship. Self-Paced gives you the recorded content on your own schedule. Both include the same projects and certificate.
